description: Obligations Légales de Débroussaillement sur les routes - Pays d'Aix is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. Representation of Legal Brushing Obligations (OLD) within a regulatory radius of 20m on either side of the track. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Legal obligations of brush removal on the roads - Pays d'Aix" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include débroussaillement ; donnée ouverte. The listing shows 2017-03-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
